brief:
Footage documenting Gaza City's transformation shows streets and landmarks devastated by the conflict, Eye on Palestine reported. Rubble now covers areas where vibrant urban life once existed, with displacement tents erected across the altered landscape.

The visual record captures the scale of physical destruction across the city's infrastructure and public spaces. Residents who once inhabited these neighborhoods have been displaced, their former homes and gathering places reduced to debris.
dek: Footage documenting the transformation of Gaza City as a result of the war, showing how its streets and landmarks have changed, with rubble and displacement tents replacing the vibrant life that once filled them.
title: War transforms Gaza City streets into rubble and displacement camps
